item.title: Trump offers missile support to Latin American leaders to target drug cartels
item.description: Speaking to right-wing leaders at 'Shield of the Americas' summit amid ongoing Iran campaign, Trump launches 17-nation 'counter-cartel' coalition, says Cuba 'at the end of the line' The post Trump offers missile support to Latin American leaders to target drug cartels appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Families of US detainees in Iran fear they risk becoming collateral damage in war
item.description: Six Americans are believed held by Tehran, including at Evin Prison; relatives say airstrikes, poor medical care and possible retaliation put them at growing risk The post Families of US detainees in Iran fear they risk becoming collateral damage in war appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: US starts using British military bases for ‘defensive’ Iran operations
item.description: Trump taunts PM Starmer for purportedly considering sending 2 aircraft carriers to the region: 'We don’t need people that join wars after we’ve already won' The post US starts using British military bases for ‘defensive’ Iran operations appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Netanyahu tells Iranians freedom is near as Israel hits country’s oil depots for first time

item.title: Cracks emerge in Iran’s leadership as it reels under a war seen as existential
item.description: IRGC seen taking bigger role in strategy amid US-Israeli airstrikes that have killed top commanders; succession process being sped up; frontrunner Mojtaba Khamenei is untested The post Cracks emerge in Iran’s leadership as it reels under a war seen as existential appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: US bypasses congressional review to approve munitions sale to Israel

item.title: Saudi Arabia has told Iran to stop attacks, warned of possible retaliation, sources say

item.title: Two Palestinians reported killed in fresh settler attack in West Bank
item.description: Thaer Hama’el, 24, and Fares Hama’el, 57, shot dead during raid by settlers on village of Abu Falah, near Ramallah, Palestinian Authority reports, bringing toll this week to 5 The post Two Palestinians reported killed in fresh settler attack in West Bank appeared first on The Times of Israel.
